Shortcut

Google Sheets is your source

  1. Open the Sheet and edit the Catalog tab.
  2. Choose File → Download → Comma-separated values (.csv).
  3. Choose Import Sheet CSV here. The new snapshot is saved in this browser only.

This site does not automatically sync with Sheets. Import the CSV again on each device when needed. Edits to the catalog do not change your settings in Bitwig.
